title: Inexpensive and good for little people
text:
Inexpensive and good for little people. I’m a little person and I find the chair a bit uncomfortable, but I'm getting used to it. I bought the same model at Walmart.com about 2 ½ years ago and bought the second one at Amazon about two weeks ago. Despite arthritic hands, the major challenge was inserting the wheels. The other challenge was inserting the screws. Their sockets weren’t totally exposed because the imitation leather wasn’t properly punctured and there was debris in those holes. I cleared and exposed them with a paring knife and the rest of the assembly was simple, requiring the use of a hex key that comes with the chair.

Although my two chairs are the same model, the newer one’s seat and armrests aren’t as deep (or long) as the first chair, so I don’t find it as comfortable as the first. But, here’s the thing: to get the best fitting chair, you need to try it out. I sampled a few at Staples and at a local office chair store and I didn’t find any of those so called ergonomic chairs comfortable. I’ve concluded that chairs should be selected in the same manner that we search for a good pair of jeans or gloves. We need to try them out and go home with the one that gives us the best fit. Since my two same model chairs don’t feel the same, I cannot assume that all cuts are identical, so test and try before you purchase.

description: The multipurpose leather mid-back office chair is an ideal choice for your office or kid's study room. It features molded, curved armrests that reduce strain on your shoulders even when you're to sit for many hours together. This swivel desk chair features genuine Black leather on all seating surfaces for added comfort and style. The leather mid-back office chair features a cushioned seat, which can be raised or lowered to suit your comfort level. Versatile Black leather mid-back office chair is approximately 18" at its highest setting. Heavy duty office chair is available in Black and brown to blend well with any home or office decor.
